synthesis.body: A runner that iterates a list of (label, argv) and counts non-zero exits will report an entry whose file does not exist as "2 of 9 failed" — a sentence about tests that ran. Validate every entry's target before running anything and exit with a distinct code (0 pass / 1 a test failed / 2 the manifest is broken). Treat an entry from which no target path can be extracted as a manifest error too, or a bare `-m pytest` preflights clean while verifying nothing. Two entries sat red for weeks here because the message read like ordinary test failure.

title: Reporting a missing test-manifest entry as a failing test
